```plato

// A polygonal region with holes: the area inside Boundary and outside every
// hole. Invariants: holes lie strictly inside the boundary, are mutually
// disjoint, and wind opposite to it.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon_with_holes)
type PolygonWithHoles2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, IDeformable2D, IMesh2D
{
    Boundary: Polygon2D;
    Holes: Array<Polygon2D>;
}
```
